item_short_desc: The Silva Ranger 2.0 Compass is a precision navigation tool designed for outdoor enthusiasts, offering reliable performance for camping, hiking, and travel. With mirror sighting and a sighting hole, it allows for accurate long-distance navigation. Featuring a slope card, this compass enables measuring slope and extra distance, enhancing navigation accuracy. The detachable distance lanyard provides convenient scale reference for various map scales, ensuring easy route planning.
description: The Silva Ranger 2.0 Compass is a precision navigation tool designed for outdoor enthusiasts, offering reliable performance for camping, hiking, and travel. With mirror sighting and a sighting hole, it allows for accurate long-distance navigation. Featuring a slope card, this compass enables measuring slope and extra distance, enhancing navigation accuracy. The detachable distance lanyard provides convenient scale reference for various map scales, ensuring easy route planning. Constructed with durable materials, the Ranger 2.0 is built to withstand rugged outdoor conditions, ensuring long-lasting reliability. It also includes a built-in adjuster for magnetic declination, allowing for accurate compass readings in different locations. For enhanced visibility during low-light conditions, the compass features luminous markings, enabling night-time navigation. Please note that this item is restricted for export and may have usage limitations in certain countries outside the U.S. Equip yourself with the Silva Ranger 2.0 Compass for precise navigation and confident exploration in the great outdoors.
